note: loben = to vow/promise (Versprechen); 7/8 WZB samples are OT vow/oath context: "gelobt hat" = has vowed/promised (land promised, vow made, vow kept); corpus majority 49.4% is sense_6054 (praise/admiration) from non-OT texts; WZB OT uses "loben/geloben" predominantly as "to vow/pledge" (gelübde context); praise-sense (6054,6055) minor residual

dienen = service/servitude (Dienst + Diener); all 8 WZB samples are OT service contexts: serving Pharaoh, serving God, serving foreign gods; Dienst (service) + Diener (servant) senses dominate; sense_1805 (Christian rites) absent in OT; sense_1803/1804 (feudal/moral service) similar to majority sense 1806; 56.5% corpus majority

nemen = to take (Object + Decision/Acceptance/Resignation); 6/7 WZB samples are general "taking": take a wife, take to himself, take of the blood, take a parable; 44.9% corpus majority; other senses (killing 6768, naming 6769, receiving 17202) present but minority; accepted ~40% residual for the 9 remaining senses

slahen = to strike/kill (Object + Natürlicher Tod/Gewaltsamer Tod/Tod); 6/7 WZB samples are violent striking/killing (slugen mit blintheit, slach die woner, slecht einen menschen wil vorterben, der hagil slug); OT plagues/battles/execution context; corpus majority 47.3%; physical-hit-only sense (14948) minority; animal slaughter (14949) and metal-forging (17532) absent

tragen = to carry/transport (Object + Bewegung); 6/7 WZB samples are physical carrying: carry the old/dead, carry from city, carry blood, carry water, carry into earth; tabernacle/census context (Exodus/Numbers) = heavy carrying narrative; botanical yield sense (9729: samen trug = bore seed) is minority; 28.2% corpus majority understates WZB genre dominance of physical carry
